LaunchOfferCounter.title: LaunchOfferCounter
LaunchOfferCounter.description: Global atomic counter tracking total installations assigned to the 730-user launch offer (two 365-user batches).

count.description: Monotonically increasing integer count of assigned installations, strictly capped at 730.

lastUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who performed the latest atomic +1 increment.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest counter increment.

LaunchOfferClaim.title: LaunchOfferClaim
LaunchOfferClaim.description: Per-installation claim record associating an anonymous UID with a launch offer slot (1..730), created either via initial counter increment or atomic one-time recovery code consumption.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the claimant (must match document ID).

userNumber.description: Sequential 1-based installation number (1..730) assigned from LaunchOfferCounter or recovered via one-time recovery code.

batch.description: Assigned launch batch: 1 (users 1..365, 100% off Lifetime) or 2 (users 366..730, 100% off 1-Year). Batch 0 is never stored.

claimedAt.description: Server timestamp when the installation claimed or recovered its batch slot.

recoveredFromHash.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the consumed one-time recovery code when restored on a new installation.

LaunchOfferRecovery.title: LaunchOfferRecovery
LaunchOfferRecovery.description: One-time recovery record keyed by the SHA-256 hex digest of a 12-character recovery code (raw code is never stored in Firestore).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the claim owner who generated this recovery code.

userNumber.description: Sequential 1-based installation number (1..730) associated with the launch gift.

batch.description: Launch batch associated with the gift: 1 (Lifetime) or 2 (1-Year).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this one-time recovery record was created.

/launch_offer/{docId}.description: Singleton counter document (/launch_offer/counter) incremented by +1 up to 730 in an atomic transaction alongside /launch_claims/{uid}.

/launch_claims/{uid}.description: Claim document per Firebase Auth UID (created once via counter increment or updated/created via atomic recovery code transfer).

/launch_recovery/{hash}.description: One-time recovery token lookup collection keyed by SHA-256 hex digest of the user's recovery code (allow list: if false).
